name: loop-stream-break
about: 流在中途被对端直接断开（不是挂住）后的两层恢复。provider 层（model/streaming/streamModel.ts:205-222 连接阶段失败按 network_error 重试；:305-336 读流时失败：只有可见文本时按 LiteLLM 方式续写 continuationRequest.ts，empty 阶段从头重试，其余带 streamInterruption 交给循环；重试上限 DEFAULT_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES=2，:154 / :54）；循环层（agent/loop/AgentLoop.ts:1039-1072，最多 2 次）。b1：OpenAI 文本两块后断开（provider 缺省重试）；b2：OpenAI 工具调用参数只传了一半（{"file_path": "a.t）就断开，没有 finish；b3：一块都没发就断开，provider 重试用尽后按普通模型错误结束；b4：streamMaxRetries=0 的 provider，文本两块后断开 → 不做 provider 续写，循环按 text 阶段恢复；b5：Anthropic 形状，文本一块后断开；b6：Anthropic 形状，tool_use 的 input_json_delta 只传一半就断开；b7：Anthropic 形状，一块都没发就断开且 streamMaxRetries=0。retry 退避设成 1ms。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    nr:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/nr/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamMaxRetries: 0
        requestMaxRetries: 0
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    anth:
      protocol: anthropic
      url: {MOCK}
      apiKey: bbx-anthropic-key
      retry:
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        claude-bbx:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    anr:
      protocol: anthropic
      url: {MOCK}/anr
      apiKey: bbx-anthropic-key
      retry:
        streamMaxRetries: 0
        requestMaxRetries: 0
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        claude-bbx:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false

provider.name: b2-resumed
when: No incomplete tool call was executed

provider.name: b6-resumed
when: No incomplete tool call was executed
